class.name: SteamDiagnosticBatch
class.brief_description: A read-only snapshot of Steam SDK diagnostics.
class.description: [method SteamDiagnostics.drain] returns an independent snapshot of the current capture queue. Later drains or capture stops leave earlier snapshots usable.

method.name: get_dropped_count
method.description: Returns the number of additional callbacks discarded after the queue reached capacity, since capture started or since the previous drain.

method.name: get_messages
method.description: Returns the read-only array of up to 32 messages in capture order. An empty snapshot returns an empty typed array.

members.member: Read-only overflow count for this snapshot.
Read-only typed array of diagnostics in capture order.
